unit_result_entry.title: A controlled growth strip feeds Landau's theorem to widen the zero-free region
unit_result_entry.why_material: The zeta bound is rewritten in exponential form on a restricted strip, matched to Landau's phi and width functions, and converted into the Vinogradov–Korobov zero-free boundary.

unit_dependency_entry.context_note: The bounded-height completion is delegated to earlier known zero-free regions and symmetry.
unit_dependency_entry.representation_dependency: High formula dependence for the logarithmic exponents; the theorem-to-zero-free transfer is prose-supported.

neighboring_unit_entries.title: Block decomposition transfers short-sum cancellation to a near-one-line zeta bound
neighboring_unit_entries.why_material: The Hardy–Littlewood approximation is split into exponentially sized blocks; Abel summation imports the zeta-sum estimate into each weighted block, and a second grouping makes the block series summable. A different splitting point handles sigma farther from one.

neighboring_unit_entries.title: Contour truncation is balanced against the zero-free decay to optimize the PNT error
neighboring_unit_entries.why_material: Shifting the prime-number-theorem contour into the new zero-free region creates two competing error contributions; choosing the truncation height T to balance them yields the characteristic 3/5 and 1/5 exponents.

related_synthesis_entries.claim: The short-sum estimate is transferred by partial/Abel summation to zeta growth, then by Landau's theorem to a zero-free strip, and finally by contour shifting and truncation optimization to a prime-number-theorem error term.
related_synthesis_entries.limit: Several interface theorems and contour details are referenced from earlier notes rather than proved here, so the chain is source-supported but not self-contained.
